title: Maintenance Fluids (Holliday-Segar)

changelog.change: Tier 1 verification: 4-2-1 piecewise confirmed. Noted that the 24-h figure uses 24×(4-2-1) ≈ 96/48/24 mL/kg/day, marginally below the exact daily method (100/50/20).
Initial entry from Drug_Dosing_Peds_Weight_Based_Spec.md — one reusable formula, not a lookup table.

purpose: Standard pediatric maintenance IV fluid rate (the 4-2-1 rule) and the 24-hour volume.

interpretation.label: 4 mL/kg/h for the first 10 kg + 2 mL/kg/h for the next 10 kg + 1 mL/kg/h for each kg beyond 20. Use an isotonic, dextrose-containing fluid for most inpatients; reduce for SIADH, cardiac, or renal limitation.

notes: Maintenance only — replace deficits and ongoing losses separately. Adult maintenance is often capped around 100-120 mL/h. The 24-h volume here is 24 × the hourly 4-2-1 rate (≈ 96/48/24 mL/kg/day); the exact daily method gives 100/50/20 mL/kg/day — e.g. 10 kg → 960 vs 1000 mL/day.
